_comment: keywords: map of HN-title keyword -> minimum HN points required to post. A keyword matches when it appears in the story TITLE (case-insensitive substring). 'defaultMinScore' applies to any keyword whose value is null. Keys are also used as the Algolia search queries. Many keywords are derived from the bioelectricitynexus.com glossary (https://bioelectricitynexus.com/glossary). Generic single words from the glossary (e.g. 'Agency') are intentionally omitted to avoid over-matching unrelated HN titles.
